facts.fact: The Central Bank of Egypt issued licensing and registration rules for payment system operators and payment service providers on 19 June 2025 under Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020, giving existing payment institutions 12 months to apply for a licence.
facts.system: CBE licensing and registration rules for PSOs and PSPs

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Egypt's rules of 19 June 2025 set licensing conditions for payment institutions, domestic and foreign-based, providing payment services or operating payment systems for customers in Egypt, with minimum capital and financial guarantee requirements.
facts.system: CBE licensing and registration rules for PSOs and PSPs
